info.name: 4. Helpdesk Service - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Helpdesk Service API - Organized by modules:
1. Issue Master - Predefined issue types (category/subcategory/component/spare part)
2. Issue Tickets - Create/raise and manage tickets
3. Queries - User queries
4. FAQs - Frequently asked questions
5. Escalation Matrix - SLA configuration
6. Knowledge Base - Service knowledge
7. Escalations & SLA - Issue escalation and SLA tracking
8. Chatbot - AI chatbot

Swagger: helpdesk-service/docs/swagger/helpdesk_openapi.yaml. Base URL: localhost:7074

request.description: Add issue type when not in list. Select category, subcategory, component, or spare part. At least one ref required.

body.raw:
{
  "issueTitle": "Display not working",
  "issueDescription": "Screen shows no output",
  "categoryId": 1,
  "subCategoryId": 1,
  "componentId": null,
  "sparePartId": null
}
